subject: [PATCH] mm/percpu: account full object size for percpu memory allocations

reviews.author: Joshua Hahn
reviews.summary: Identified an opportunity to unify the use of pcpu_obj_full_size(size) in several functions, suggesting a follow-up patch to clean up the code and demonstrate intent.

reviews.author: Harry Yoo (Meta)
reviews.summary: Agreed with Joshua's suggestion to unify the use of pcpu_obj_full_size(size), but suggested keeping a distinction between 'full_size' and 'size' in mm/percpu.c.

2026-10-14.patch_summary: The patch aims to account for the full object size in percpu memory allocations.
